en: Monochrome image showing a Renaissance-style courtyard staircase attached to a substantial stone building. The double-flight exterior stairs have balustrades and are supported by heavy columns with arches beneath. At the top of the stairs stand three slender pinnacles or obelisks. In the background are vaulted loggias with rounded arches and balustrades on the upper floor, and a decorated ceiling in the upper arcade. The scene appears to be an inner courtyard of a historical civic or palace building in a European city. There is no printed caption or visible handwriting on the image side.
